# paddle_subscription (Data Source)

Look up an existing Paddle subscription, either directly by `id` or by `customer_id`/`status` filters — closes the discovery gap the `paddle_subscription_cancel`/`pause`/`resume`/`charge` actions otherwise have, since each of those requires a `subscription_id` with no other in-Terraform way to find one. See [Paddle API Reference](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/subscriptions/overview). If `id` is set, every other filter is ignored and that subscription is fetched directly. Otherwise, `customer_id` and/or `status` are applied as server-side filters and exactly one subscription must match — zero or more than one match is an error, not a silent first-result pick.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paddle_subscription" "example" {
  # Look up directly by ID
  id = "sub_..." # replace with a real subscription ID

  # Or look up by customer_id + status (exactly one must match):
  # customer_id = "ctm_..."
  # status      = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Filter by the owning customer's ID (prefix `ctm_...`). Ignored if `id` is set.
- `id` (String) Paddle subscription ID (prefix `sub_...`) to look up directly. Leave unset to look up by `customer_id`/`status` instead.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: one of `active`, `canceled`, `past_due`, `paused`, `trialing`. Ignored if `id` is set. Also returned (computed) with the matched subscription's actual status.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time this subscription was created, set by Paddle.
- `currency_code` (String) ISO 4217 code for the subscription's primary currency.
- `next_billed_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time of the next scheduled billing, or `null` if there isn't one (e.g., a canceled/paused subscription).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time this subscription was last updated, set by Paddle.
